title: Timeout-settle lapsed approval windows
description: Scan SUBMITTED jobs whose approval window has lapsed with no originator action and call timeoutSettle permissionlessly. One accepted job covers one settlement: identify the job, send the transaction, submit the tx hash as the result.
requirements: Funded self-custody wallet for gas on the target chain
Ability to read job approvalDeadline from the subgraph
deliverables: Onchain timeoutSettle transaction for a genuinely lapsed job
context: Silent originators stall escrow and agent payouts. The protocol allows anyone to close a lapsed window via timeoutSettle, but nobody watches the clock. This job pays for watching: fully verifiable from protocol events alone, no external feed, no human judge.

params.note: Target the jobId in timeoutableNow from job_liveness at execution time

asserts: job was SUBMITTED with approvalDeadline in the past at execution time
TimeoutSettled event exists for the jobId, followed by JobSettled
timeoutSettle transaction sender may be anyone (permissionless)
